correctness.rationale: The frozen results are numerically and mathematically correct; the repaired finding narrows the contribution, not the count. Half of each even letter multiplicity can be placed in each subword, and all permutations of ≤3 positions are dihedral. In the length-eight witness any candidate must give both subwords letters {0,0,1,2}; the subword containing the zero at position 6 reads 0102, and its complement 0012. One has opposite zeros and the other adjacent zeros on the four-cycle. There are C(4,2)·2·2=24 oriented balanced splits. For the repaired orbit statement, rotating an entire word simply rotates both induced subwords, and reversing or renaming the word also preserves the predicate. An alphabet permutation in a stabilizer must fix the dominant letter, and a rotation preserving its position set must fix its unique isolated occurrence, hence is trivial. The rotation/relabeling orbit has exactly 48 distinct failures. A separately written literal enumeration of all lengths 2,4,6,8 and all candidate splits yields 3,21,183,1641 even words, 0,0,0,48 failures, and the four specified classes of 12. Thus the orbit is exhaustive and the classification checks at the stated finer equivalence relation.
residual_risks: Exhaustion stops at length eight; no density or classification claim at higher lengths.

originality.rationale: PASS is for the repaired exhaustive classification only. The frozen presentation of the refutation as a distinct finding failed originality in that part: the separate indexed seven-permutation result's complete permitted-permutation row already certifies exactly the same witness, regardless of priority. Rotations and relabelings give all 48 proposed failures from that witness, and the half-length argument rules out shorter ones. The repair explicitly credits that coverage and claims exhaustiveness (no additional length-eight failures) and the resulting census only. The inspected comparison supplies neither a full D4 membership table nor an upper bound of 48 failing words. Same-day indexing does not determine priority.
residual_risks: Catalogue and literature searches are bounded; an unindexed or differently worded complete census is not ruled out.

value.rationale: Even without novelty for a first witness, exhausting the first failing length of a named conjecture answers a natural structural question: every minimal failure follows by rotation and relabeling from one pattern, and none is of another kind. The exact labeled census and the four explicitly defined smaller orbits make this finite boundary usable for comparing strengthened shuffle restrictions. This is not a recount of one observed counterexample or an arbitrary slice.
residual_risks: The four classes are only under the stated smaller group; no general result about longer obstructions.
